'''Colt''' is a worker for the [[Averardo Vault]] Underground. He can be found talking with his coworker [[Armand]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Colt:''' I'm telling you, there's something wrong with that statue we dropped off...
:'''Colt:''' How is the whole thing still intact, except for a scratch on the base? Could it be some kind of trigger for a nobleman's hidden chamber?
:'''Colt:''' And the statue itself... [[Frostscourge Stalker|Frostscourge Stalkers]] are symbols of death and vengeance, you know! Maybe there's a rebellion brewing in that secret chamber...
:'''Armand:''' Oh, shut it. If you've got time for daydreaming, go take up volunteering at the Order.
:'''Colt:''' Ah, you're no fun.
:'''Colt:''' We haul these treasures down the express every day. It's a golden opportunity to uncover all the nobles' dirty little secrets.
:'''Armand:''' You know the vault monitors everything, right? Cameras and audio, all synced to record every word you say.
:'''Colt:''' So what?
:'''Armand:''' What I'm saying is, they're watching the items... and listening to you.
:'''Armand:''' And if you so much as slip and reveal one of their "secrets"? Well, that could turn very ugly for you. 
{{Dialogue End}}
